scope: Real RoadsterSim numerical integration, production read-only filters, and the actual main camera updater executed against real Three camera math with inert DOM/menu fixtures. Not browser/native-keyboard, GPU or human comfort acceptance.

checks.name: Actual RoadsterSim trajectories and complete snapshots are identical with head/audio feedback enabled or disabled at every fixed step
Offset is bounded, follows local acceleration direction and never introduces camera rotation
Pause freezes the presentation state; repeated frames do not integrate it, and seek/reset clears old inertial memory
The production main camera updater leaves fixed/orbit/chase/top and review camera poses independent of head feedback

physicalIsolation.interpretation: Numerical full-city integration. Enabling the read-only presentation filter and sound state does not change any captured physical continuation state.

limits.stressMeaning: Synthetic large acceleration probes a presentation bound, not a physical vehicle maneuver

pauseAndSeek.pause: holds current bounded offset and freezes filter time; it does not force the current camera to neutral
pauseAndSeek.repeatedFrame: no integration at identical physical time
pauseAndSeek.reenable: starts at neutral, without a stale velocity impulse

evidence.reviewCockpit: inactive presentation filter; exact nominal recorded-frame geometry
